definitions.explanation: The year two years ago from the present. More formal than the colloquial おととし.

examples.japanese: {一昨年|いっさくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved the summer before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨年|いっさくねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I've been studying Japanese since the year before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨年|いっさくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Compared to sales from the year before last, this year's have increased significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
{一昨年|いっさくねん} is the formal reading used in writing and formal speech. The colloquial equivalent is ⟦おととし→おととし：02895_ototoshi⟧, which is more common in everyday conversation. Both mean the same thing.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦おととし→おととし：02895_ototoshi⟧ / {一昨年|いっさくねん} (year before last)
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧ / ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧ (last year)
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧ (this year)
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧ (next year)
- ⟦{再来年|さらいねん}→再来年：01417_sarainen⟧ (year after next)
- ⟦{一昨日|いっさくじつ}→一昨日：16681_issakujitsu⟧ / ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧ (day before yesterday)
